# Legal and Regulatory Risk Optimization Strategy

The following urgent actions are required for risk optimization:

*   Optimize legal risks urgently.
*   Review regulatory changes based on audit findings.
*   Review Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor legal risks urgently.
*   Review Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection quarterly.
